verdict.summary: Round 5 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The implementation still elects exactly one deterministic saver per cache_crate using feature breadth, weight, and stable group identity, while the workflow retains the main-ref guard and the posture test permits only registered, proven narrowing conjuncts. The focused tests cover per-key uniqueness, widest-feature preference, order-independent tie-breaking, workflow wiring, and real-generator non-vacuity. The local targeted suite could not run because PyYAML is absent; the non-vacuity proof intentionally fails closed in that condition and CI installs the dependency. Findings are unchanged from round 4, so progress is stagnant.
